description: This file defines an interface named ExceptionContextProvider used in the Apache Commons Math library. The interface provides a method to access exception context data used for customizing error messages and storing key-value pairs in exceptions.

classes.name: ExceptionContextProvider
classes.description: Interface for accessing the context data structure stored in Commons Math exceptions.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns a reference to the exception context, which can be used to store key-value pairs and customize error messages.
